swistrackcomponent.friendlyname: Output Tracks to a CSV File
swistrackcomponent.description: Writes all tracks into a single CSV file with the columns frame,id,x,y,vx,vy (one row per track and frame in which the track was updated).

configuration.label: Relative file names are written into the run folder (e.g. "testing/tracks.csv" next to the configuration file when running SwisTrack-batch).
